alt_text: An open blank notebook, a closed-screen laptop, and a glass of water sit on a light wooden desk in a bright room near a window. in Barrio de Salamanca, Madrid. Text on the image: Free lesson plans, ready to teach
caption:
A good lesson built on authentic material usually follows a simple shape, and it is the shape our plans use. First, a short lead-in so students activate what they already know about the topic. Then the news story or video for gist only: what is this about, and who is involved? Only after that do you go back for detail and language. Pre-teach four or five words, no more. Choose the ones students need to understand the story, not every unfamiliar item. Finish with a task where students use the language to react, argue or decide something. That is the moment real material becomes real speaking. Our free plans are built this way: real news and video, a student worksheet, slides and a teacher plan, from A2 to C1.
